_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Constance Garnett (1861-1946) and her Russians. Each TITLE is its own work with its own slug; author sections (a Dostoevsky or Tolstoy section later) cross-reference these slugs, never a second copy. SOURCES are fetched by fetch_shelf.py; TITLES (one volume, or several joined) by split_shelf_titles.py. Rights: every title here was first published 1894-1927, so US public domain (published before 1931); UK public domain since 2017 (Garnett d. 1946). 'translated' = first publication of her translation; 'scan_edition' = the printing actually scanned when it is a later one. Gutenberg titles were checked for the PG Translator line (fetch report). No uids minted in the relay burst.
